source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.BasicCategoryTheory
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 1.5 and 1.11: non-exercise identity laws and inverse uniqueness. Assigned exercise solutions are withheld.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.CategoryConstructions
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 1.5–1.13, 1.18, 1.20, 1.22, 3.2 and 3.5: ordinary definitions, examples and supplied laws. Assigned construction checks are withheld.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.CategorySize
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 1.4, 1.8 and 1.16: type-universe size and local smallness. These are explicitly scoped type-theoretic formulations, not a literal ZFSet encoding of all categories.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.ConcreteGroupPresentations
source_modules.paperMapping: Introduction: actual integer carriers {0,1} and {1,-1}, addition modulo two versus multiplication, isomorphism and unequal numerical identities.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.FiniteSetCategories
source_modules.paperMapping: Exact finite set-coded terminal category, walking isomorphism, object-selection uniqueness and inclusion equivalence.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.PathAndIdentity
source_modules.paperMapping: Introduction: endpoint-fixed path homotopies, their ordinary fundamental groupoid, and group invariants. This does not construct the full infinity-groupoid or prove univalence.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetCategories
source_modules.paperMapping: Source category, functor, contravariant functor and natural-transformation definitions with literal set-universe membership; proved data-preserving Mathlib correspondences.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetCategoryCodes
source_modules.paperMapping: Injective complete category codes with actual universe bounds and data-preserving restriction/enlargement.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetCategoryEquivalences
source_modules.paperMapping: Exact set-coded formulations of 3.1 and 3.4–3.7, including both equivalences of an adjoint equivalence and the adjoint upgrade.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetCategoryModels
source_modules.paperMapping: General operation-preserving correspondence between specified ZFC object/hom codes and modeled categories; explicit fully faithful functor restrictions.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetCategoryPresentation
source_modules.paperMapping: Introduction to equivalences: strict inverse functors require an object bijection; the exact singleton and walking-isomorphism categories are not strictly isomorphic.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetFreeVectors
source_modules.paperMapping: Actual finitely supported coefficient graphs, their source-universe bounds and proved linear correspondence to the direct sum.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetFunctions
source_modules.paperMapping: Proved correspondence between functions of ZFC membership types and set-coded function graphs.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetFunctorCodes
source_modules.paperMapping: Injective exact functor codes in an explicit small bounding set.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetIndexedFamilies
source_modules.paperMapping: ZFC graphs of indexed set families, injectivity and closure under the source universe assumptions.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetOption
source_modules.paperMapping: Disjoint addition of a distinguished point, with explicit Option equivalence and source-universe bound.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetRepresentableIsomorphism
source_modules.paperMapping: Non-exercise Corollary 2.7 with actual small-set-valued representables and componentwise natural isomorphisms; library prerequisites reused internally.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetSubsets
source_modules.paperMapping: Bijective correspondence between subsets of membership types and actual ZFC subsets.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetUniverseClosure
source_modules.paperMapping: Products and function sets derived from exactly the four stated set-universe assumptions.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SetUniverses
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 1.1–1.4: ZFSet universe closure assumptions and consequences. Introduction: equality substitution and transport. Universe existence is assumed, not proved.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallCategoryUniverse
source_modules.paperMapping: Remark 1.16: all source-small categories, small functor hom sets, non-small object collection, and exact huge-category inclusion.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallPointedAdjunction
source_modules.paperMapping: The add-basepoint functor and unit/counit adjunction on the actual small-set categories, with proved commuting model squares.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallPointedSets
source_modules.paperMapping: Actual pointed small-set category, exact morphism graphs, size bounds, non-smallness, isomorphism test and forgetful functor.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallSetsCategory
source_modules.paperMapping: Example 1.8 and 1.10, Set case only: all small ZFC sets, actual function sets, local smallness, non-smallness and bijective isomorphisms.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallTopologicalAdjunctions
source_modules.paperMapping: Exact discrete, forgetful and indiscrete functors; stated open-set families and both source adjunctions.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallTopologicalSpaces
source_modules.paperMapping: All small topological spaces encoded by their carrier and open-set family; continuous graph morphisms, size bounds and homeomorphism test.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallVectorAdjunction
source_modules.paperMapping: Free and forgetful vector functors, their exact adjunction and non-smallness of the vector-space object collection.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SmallVectorSpaces
source_modules.paperMapping: All vector-space structures on small ZFC sets, injective operation codes, linear graphs and the bijective isomorphism criterion.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SourceConstructionData
source_modules.paperMapping: Approved source data/formulas in 1.15, 1.17, 1.21, 1.23, 1.28, 2.2, 2.6 and 3.3. Only raw components and definitional readbacks; assigned laws, naturality, inverses and triangles remain withheld.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.SourceLaws
source_modules.paperMapping: Ordinary-category supporting results. Exact source coverage is determined by source-audit.json, not by the module label.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.TerminalCategory
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 1.25, 1.27, 3.8 and 3.9: terminal category and finite example. The strict evaluation isomorphism assigned in 1.26 is withheld.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.WalkingIsomorphism
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 1.25, 3.4, 3.8 and 3.9: one-object and two-object singleton-hom categories, an explicit adjoint equivalence and two-object cardinality.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.YonedaAdjunction
source_modules.paperMapping: Primary 2.3, the non-assigned part of 2.6, 2.7, 3.1 and 3.4–3.7: definitions, non-exercise consequences and equivalence criterion. Assigned Yoneda/adjunction correspondence proofs are withheld.

source_modules.name: ILab.MathematicsLearning.YonedaConstruction
source_modules.paperMapping: Theorem 2.1, page 9: author-supplied evaluation at identity and candidate component functions on exact small-set carriers. Only defining formulas are checked; candidate naturality, mutual inverseness and naturality in c,F remain assigned. The complete Yoneda theorem is not verified here.
